bullets.title: American Symphony
bullets.note: This is the most beautiful documentary I’ve seen in a long time. If you listen carefully, there are a lot of philosophical gems worth chewing on. Here’s the official description: “In this deeply intimate documentary, musician [Jon Batiste](https://www.instagram.com/jonbatiste/?hl=en) attempts to compose a symphony as his wife, writer [Suleika Jaouad](https://tim.blog/2021/06/01/suleika-jaouad/?utm_source=convertkit&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_campaign=5bf#content), undergoes cancer treatment.” At the least, I suggest you [watch the short trailer here](https://youtu.be/wKSMsdq8ONs?si=8L7ozHUDn9hnx2CO).

bullets.title: Ketamine is being sold as a depression wonder drug. For some, it’s making everything worse.
bullets.note: Please try [this alternate link](https://archive.is/5BVLl) if you have any trouble accessing the article. This is a timely and important piece by [Anna Silman](https://www.annasilman.com/) ([@annaesilman](https://twitter.com/annaesilman)). In the last three years, I’ve seen more high-functioning people derailed by ketamine than any other substance.

bullets.title: Book Startup Pitches Authors a Novel Deal: $0 Up Front, Bigger Profits
bullets.note:
(_Wall Street Journal_) and **“**[**A New Publisher Promises Authors ‘the Lion’s Share of the Profit’**](https://www.nytimes.com/2024/03/05/books/publisher-authors-equity.html?unlocked_article_code=1.aU0._odM.L_GTaC8maku4&smid=url-share)**”** (_New York Times_). I’m thrilled to be involved with this new venture in publishing. I hope it sets new precedents in an age-old industry that’s ripe for innovation. You can find the Authors Equity website [here](http://authorsequity.com/).  
​  
For more on unorthodox approaches to publishing and book deals (e.g., how can you hit the NYT list with self-published books?), check out next week’s podcast with one of the most successful present-day authors.
